newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier lifts offer for Discovery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier lifts offer for Discovery.

text.p: Discovery Petroleum NL said on Thursday Premier Oil Plc increased its offer for Discovery to 80 cents a share from 70 cents.
The increase lifts the value of Premier's offer to A$106.5 million from A$91.9 million.

A statement to the stock exchange said Premier's offer was now only conditional on 50.1 percent acceptance, no material adverse changes, and Foreign Investment Review Board approval, which was expected shortly.
U.K.-based Premier announced that it intended to bid for Discovery on September 23.
Discovery shares were untraded on Thursday.
The stock closed at 77 cents on Wednesday.
